question: A total of 7,50,000 voters participated in the election. A candidate received 3,82,500 votes which was 60% of the total valid votes. What was the percentage of invalid votes in the election?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Candidate's votes as % of total votes = (3,82,500 ÷ 7,50,000) × 100 = 51%

Valid votes = 51% × (100 ÷ 60) = 85% of total votes.

Percentage of invalid votes = 100% − 85% = 15%

**∴ The correct answer is 15%.**
